benefits.name: Software Credit
benefits.description: Automatic $100 statement credit per 12-month period after 11 consecutive months of eligible software service purchases.
benefits.terms: $100 per 12-month period, applied within 1-2 statement billing cycles after 11 consecutive months of recurring software service purchases made directly with a software service provider. Eligible providers are identified by Merchant Category Code; purchases through discount/retail stores or online retailers may not qualify. Issuer terms don't say what date the 12-month period starts from, so renewalPeriod is left out.

earningRates.terms: Prepaid hotel and car reservations booked directly in the U.S. Bank Travel Center (1% base + 4% additional).
Excludes wholesale clubs and discount stores/supercenters. Gas or EV charging purchases greater than $200 are not treated as automotive fuel and earn 1%.
Restaurants and restaurant delivery, office supply stores, and cell phone service providers.
